description: This file contains unit tests for the DeleteAttributesLiveCommandImpl class, a component involved in handling delete attribute commands in a live editing context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests immutability, equality, construction, and string representation, and uses mock objects and assertions related to command handling.

classes.name: DeleteAttributesLiveCommandImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DeleteAttributesLiveCommandImpl, ensuring correct behavior such as immutability, equality, construction, and string representation.

methods.description: Checks that DeleteAttributesLiveCommandImpl instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies proper implementation of hashCode() and equals() methods.

methods.name: tryToGetDeleteAttributesLiveCommandForNull
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to the factory method throws NullPointerException.
